title: DNN stratifies kidney cancer survival using ten cuproptosis-related genes
summary: A deep neural network trained on ten cuproptosis-related gene-expression features stratified kidney clear-cell cancer survival in TCGA and was evaluated in an external ICGC dataset. The authors report AUCs of 0.739 in training and 0.707 in validation. This was retrospective database analysis;  proposed drug-target interactions remain computational predictions and clinical benefit was not tested.
organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine; University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

source_review.scope: Primary full paper Methods, Results and limitations plus Europe PMC bibliographic metadata;reviewed 2026-11-21.

evidence.tested: Retrospective TCGA survival modeling and external ICGC evaluation.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance, clinical benefit and predicted drug-target mechanisms were not established.
evidence.ai_role: A three-hidden-layer DNN trained on ten cuproptosis-related expression features in TCGA predicts KIRC survival with external ICGC evaluation.
